newsitem.title: USA: Aqua Vie reorganization plan hearing set.
newsitem.headline: Aqua Vie reorganization plan hearing set.

text.p: Aqua Vie Beverage Corp said Monday a federal court in Idaho has approved its disclosure statement, which includes its reorganization plan, and that a hearing to confirm the plan has been set for October 23.
Court approval allows the plan to be sent to Aqua Vie shareholders and creditors for approval, and copies of the plan and ballots are expected to be sent in about 10 days, the company said.

The proposed plan calls for an initial funding of $625,000 to be available to the company upon the plan's confirmation. It also provides for the issuance of stock to Aqua Vie's creditors, existing shareholders and to new investors and new company financing of up to $7.725 million, the company said.
